resources.string: The save location or source is not ready. Please select again.
The source or page has changed. Please select the save location again.
No usable folder is remembered. First explicitly choose a folder in ordinary media save location settings.
The source or page has changed. Media has not been created yet; please select again.
The folder selection page has changed, so this result will not become the save location. Please select again; system permission can be managed in system settings.
The folder picker is not ready. Please try again later.

This device has reached the safety limit for folder picker associations; retrying cannot recover it. Existing tasks are kept. You can still use the App Library, the album, or a one-time Save a copy action in the library.
The previous system folder selection has not returned. Close or complete that picker first. No new picker was opened this time; the App Library is still available.
The folder picker association record is unavailable. Old associations have not been reset or reused. You can still use the App Library, the album, or a one-time Save a copy action in the library.
The association for this folder selection could not be saved safely. The system picker has not been opened. Check device storage before retrying.
The system folder picker could not open. Please try again later.
Folder selection was canceled. The previous save location is unchanged.

The folder selection result could not be confirmed. The save location needs to be checked again. The system may have retained permission; you can manage it in system settings. The original will not be deleted.

Folder permission records have reached the safety limit on this device, so a new folder cannot be remembered for now. Existing tasks and records are kept. Revoking system permission does not clear this record. You can still use the App Library, the album, or a one-time Save a copy action in the library.
This folder selection could not be adopted. The system may have retained permission; check system settings. Selecting again does not revive old permissions detected as invalid. The original is kept.
Newly created media will keep the App Library original and save an extra copy to the selected folder. The file provider may sync to the cloud; the copy may be visible before verification.
Permission or settings changed after folder selection. Newly created media will use the save location currently displayed; the original is kept.
The save location change was canceled. Late results will not be adopted. System permission can be managed in system settings.

This folder is no longer remembered. New media will default to the App Library. Accepted tasks and unconfirmed copies still use their original choice. System permission has not been revoked, so those tasks and copies can still be processed or cleaned up. You can manage permission manually in system settings; revoking it may require you to clean up leftover copies yourself.
Folder permission is no longer valid. New media will default to the App Library. Explicitly select a folder again. Old operations will not automatically recreate copies; the original is kept.
Extra copy status is temporarily unavailable. The App Library original is kept. You can resume checking later.
Cancellation of this extra copy was requested. Waiting for reading and writing to stop and for cleanup to be checked; the App Library original is kept.
This copy has completed, entered final commit, or is temporarily unavailable for cancellation. Please resume checking. The App Library original is kept.

The remembered folder choice is no longer available. New media will default to the App Library. Explicitly select a folder again when you need a folder copy. Tasks with old invalid permissions will not automatically recreate copies; the original is kept.
The ordinary media save location is temporarily unavailable. Existing originals are kept. Please resume checking unconfirmed extra copies.
The save location operation is temporarily busy. Please try again later.
Album copy
Folder copy
%1$s: not selected for this media
%1$s: waiting for this media to be verified and saved in the App Library
%1$s: waiting to copy
%1$s: fully verified and saved
%1$s: incomplete. This copy operation will not delete the App Library original. Check the source in the library, then explicitly choose Save a copy again
%1$s: in progress or awaiting verification of the result. Please resume checking. No duplicate copy will be created automatically
